title: Overgrow
body:
Let the world **OVERGROW** itself. 

**A system where blocks slowly spread and transform over time.**

![Overgrow-Text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e16c68f0bcc3f1729f54142e69a5f562037d0fd.png)
## ⚠️Early Development Version

This mod is currently in a **very early stage of development**.  
Many planned features are **not** yet implemented, and the system is still being expanded and reworked.

Right now, the mod focuses on a **basic block transformation system** that lays the foundation for the future "**overgrowth**" mechanic.

# 🌿Current Features
**Transformations**:
- Cobblestone > Mossy Cobblestone (#mossy) [100%]
- Stone Bricks > Mossy Stone Bricks (#mossy) [100%]
- Stone Bricks > Cracked Stone Bricks (#air) [10%]
- Dirt > Mud (#water) [50%]
- Mud > Dirt (#air) [40%]

## 🔮 Planned Features
The goal of the mod is to create a **living world system**, where blocks gradually:
- spread across the environment  
- transform based on surroundings  
- create natural-looking overgrowth and corruption  
- evolve over time into new forms  

More transformation types, spreading mechanics, and environmental interactions will be added in future updates.

## 💡 Note
This is an **experimental project**.  
Expect frequent changes, reworks, and unstable behavior in future versions.
